name: United States
description: Follow United States, a tracked place, in Lootura: recent changes, timeline, related context, and source-backed evidence.

changes.title: State Department revokes visa of Brazil's ambassador to the U.S.
changes.summary: A senior State Department official said the visa would be reinstated immediately if Brazil grants diplomatic approval for President Trump's nominee for U.S. ambassador to Brazil, Daniel Perez.

changes.title: What’s missing from the White House plan for the future of US science
changes.summary: Nature, Published online: 04 August 2026; doi:10.1038/d41586-026-02384-w To realize ‘a new golden age for science’, the United States needs open borders and must properly fund studies in the social sciences, public health and the humanities — not just research in technology and engineering.

changes.title: John James wins Michigan Republican gubernatorial primary, CBS News projects
changes.summary: U.S. Rep. John James, endorsed by President Trump, is projected to be the winner of Tuesday's Republican gubernatorial primary race in Michigan, according to CBS News.

changes.title: Inside the Oval Office Showdown Between Trump and Jeanine Pirro
changes.summary: Jeanine Pirro, the U.S. attorney for the District of Columbia, told President Trump that his interior secretary, Doug Burgum, had misled him with a self-serving cover story for his own mistakes.

changes.title: Fuego volcano spews more ash and mud as Guatemala shelters 1,700 who fled nearby villages
changes.summary: Guatemala remained on alert Tuesday after evacuating villages during an eruption of the Fuego volcano, one of Central America's most active.

changes.title: Trump Administration Revokes Visa of Brazil’s Ambassador in the U.S.
changes.summary: The State Department has canceled the visa of the Brazilian ambassador in Washington, deepening a diplomatic crisis between the two countries.

changes.title: Missouri Voters Reject Measure to Limit Their Ballot Box Powers
changes.summary: The state’s conservative Legislature had put the measure on the ballot that would have enacted citizen initiatives only if they won majorities in each of Missouri’s eight U.S. House districts.

changes.title: What Gives Me Hope About the Future of Public Health in the U.S.
changes.summary: A health worker prepares a dose of the measles vaccine at a health center in Lubbock, Texas, on Feb. 27, 2025. —Ronaldo Schemidt—AFP/Getty Images Periods of disruption have often forced societies to rethink old assumptions, create new institutions, and find novel ways to solve problems. I have been thinking about that.

changes.title: Trump administration revokes Brazilian ambassador’s visa in diplomatic dispute
changes.summary: The Trump administration revoked the visa of Brazil’s U.S. ambassador Tuesday — the latest jab in a monthslong diplomatic spat between the two countries.

changes.title: Pirro Meets With Trump at the White House After He Said She ‘Choked’ in Reflecting Pool Case
changes.summary: President Trump said Jeanine Pirro, the U.S. attorney for Washington, D.C., “folded like an umbrella.” For now, her job appeared to be safe, according to two people familiar with the meeting.
